description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing localisation identifiers in an OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting identifiers, along with generating views and handling user permissions.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation identifiers in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point; loads the identifier view with necessary data and layout components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to list identifiers, calling getList and returning its output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of identifiers, generating the view with the data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an identifier, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for creating or updating an identifier, with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected identifiers after permission check.
